papers.title: In situ elaboration of a binary Ti–26Nb alloy by selective laser melting of elemental titanium and niobium mixed powders
papers.first_author_affiliation: Laboratoire d'Etude des Microstructures et de Mécanique des Matériaux LEM3 (UMR CNRS 7239), Université de Lorraine, Ile de Saulcy, F-57045 Metz, France

corresponding_authors.name: Pascal Laheurte
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Laboratoire d'Etude des Microstructures et de Mécanique des Matériaux LEM3 (UMR CNRS 7239), Université de Lorraine, Ile de Saulcy, F-57045 Metz, France

llm.relevance_to_user: 主要是关于钛铌合金的SLM制备，没有涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve porous implant structures, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过SLM直接混合元素粉末制备低模量钛铌合金
summary_zh.method: 使用SLM对Ti和Nb混合粉末进行原位合金化
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了Ti-26Nb合金，具有均匀的微观结构和良好的力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate a low-modulus Ti-Nb alloy via selective laser melting of elemental powders for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: In situ alloying of Ti and Nb mixed powders during the SLM process.
summary_en.result: A Ti-26Nb alloy with uniform microstructure and favorable mechanical properties was obtained.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization (XRD, SEM) and mechanical testing.

papers.title: Effects of the microstructure and porosity on properties of Ti-6Al-4V ELI alloy fabricated by electron beam melting (EBM)
papers.first_author_affiliation: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Integrative Materials Design Center, 100 Institute Road, Worcester, MA 01609, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Haize Galarraga
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Integrative Materials Design Center, 100 Institute Road, Worcester, MA 01609, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究EBM钛合金的微观结构和孔隙率对性能的影响，为植入物制造提供工艺参考，但未涉及具体生物力学匹配或疲劳分析。
llm.why_not_core: No link to stress shielding/stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or surface roughness data.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究电子束熔化Ti-6Al-4V ELI合金的微观结构和孔隙率对力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过不同工艺参数制备EBM试样，进行显微观察和力学测试
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率和微观结构显著影响合金的拉伸强度、硬度和延展性
summary_zh.validation: 采用扫描电镜、X射线和力学试验机进行表征

summary_en.motivation: To understand how the microstructure and porosity of electron beam melted Ti-6Al-4V ELI alloy affect its mechanical properties for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: EBM samples were fabricated with varying process parameters, then characterized using SEM, XRD, and mechanical testing (tensile, hardness).
summary_en.result: Porosity and microstructure (alpha/beta phases) strongly influence the tensile strength, hardness, and ductility of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through standardized mechanical tests (ASTM) and microstructural analysis.
